nodes.name: YouTube Top-K Videos
nodes.what: Serves 100 most viewed videos for hour day all-time
nodes.why: Show what is trending without scanning all views

nodes.name: Viewer Apps
nodes.what: Reports views and requests top-100 lists
nodes.why: Outside caller that produces views and consumes rankings

nodes.name: Top-K Gateway
nodes.what: Serves top-100 queries by time window
nodes.why: Single entry to validate reads and serve rankings fast

flags.intent: Top-K Gateway serves top-100 queries by time window via reads from Redis
flags.difference: Delivered handler queries Cassandra counts table and sorts in request path instead of lookup of ready top-100 per window in Redis, breaking fast cached reads

nodes.name: View Ingest
nodes.why: Decouple view tracking from ranking computation

nodes.name: View Stream
nodes.what: Kafka topic buffering view events partitioned by video id
nodes.why: Absorb 1B views/day 50k/s peak for parallel counting

nodes.name: Window Aggregator
nodes.what: Flink workers counting views and building top-100 per window
nodes.why: Maintain hour day all-time rankings at 1min freshness

nodes.name: Ranking Store
nodes.what: Persists per-video counts and top-K lists
nodes.why: Durable source for counts and recovery

nodes.name: Top-K Cache
nodes.what: Redis holding ready top-100 lists per window

nodes.name: Approximate Counter
nodes.what: Count-min sketch per video per window
nodes.why: Count 50k views/s without exact per-event state

nodes.name: Top-K Heap
nodes.why: Keep ranked top-100 ready to push to Redis

nodes.name: Event Deduper
nodes.what: Drops duplicate and late view events by event id
nodes.why: Keeps counts exact-once at 50k views/s without double counting retries

nodes.name: Rank Publisher
nodes.what: Writes top-100 lists to store and cache every 1min
nodes.why: Gives gateway fresh rankings without querying Flink state

nodes.name: Window Assigner
nodes.what: Routes views into hour day all-time tumbling windows
nodes.why: Shares one stream for all three top-100 windows at 1min updates

nodes.name: All-Time Batch Ranker
nodes.what: Hourly batch job recomputing all-time top-100
nodes.why: All-time needs exact counts not sketch

nodes.name: Exact All-Time Counter
nodes.what: Cassandra counter table for exact all-time views
nodes.why: Keeps exact all-time counts for batch ranking
